tools.name: x402_verify
tools.description: Verify one or more XDR-1 signed receipts offline (free). Returns valid/invalid per receipt with signer recovery, declared signer comparison, and integrity digest. Supply raw_receipt as JSON string or array for batch.

tools.name: price_lookup
tools.description: Look up pricing for any code402 tool (free). Returns current x402 pricing tiers, accepted networks, and tool availability. Use tool_name for named lookups or url for URL-based lookups.

tools.name: iban_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.05). Validate an IBAN: ISO 13616 structure, country registration, length, MOD 97-10 checksum. Returns pass/fail with all checks and issues. Covers 50 countries.

tools.name: sanctions_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.05). Screen Ethereum addresses and entity names against OFAC/UN/EU sanctions lists. Returns clear/hit with matched entries. Supports both EVM addresses and human-readable names.

tools.name: onchain_address_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.05). Validate an EVM address format and EIP-55 mixed-case checksum. Returns valid/invalid with normalization and checksum status.

tools.name: lei_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.05). Validate a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI, ISO 17442). Checks 20-char alphanumeric format and Mod 97-10 check character. Verified via Rust WASM engine.

tools.name: luhn_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.05). Validate a payment card or account number using the Luhn algorithm (ISO/IEC 7812-1). Checks numeric format and Mod-10 checksum. Verified via Rust WASM engine.

tools.name: mod97_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.05). Calculate ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 remainder for any alphanumeric string. Returns the remainder (0-96, valid=1). Used for IBAN, LEI, and custom identifier validation. Verified via Rust WASM engine.

tools.name: bundle_verify
tools.description: Paid ($0.05–$0.25). Multi-gate compliance bundle: run any combination of IBAN validation, sanctions screening, and EVM address validation in a single call. Returns all gate results + XDR-1 signed receipt. Tier auto-detected from field count.

tools.name: chain_block_number
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get the latest Ethereum mainnet block number. Returns block height and timestamp.

tools.name: chain_balance
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get native ETH balance of any Ethereum address. Returns balance in wei and ETH.

tools.name: chain_erc20_balance
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get ERC-20 token balance via balanceOf. Returns balance in raw and human-readable form.

tools.name: chain_nonce
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get the next transaction nonce for an Ethereum address.

tools.name: chain_tx
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get Ethereum transaction details by hash. Returns from, to, value, gas used, status, block info.

tools.name: chain_ens_resolve
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Resolve a .eth ENS name to its Ethereum address via the universal resolver.

tools.name: chain_gas_price
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get the current Ethereum mainnet gas price. Returns base fee, priority fee, and max fee in wei and gwei. Useful for estimating transaction costs.

tools.name: chain_tx_receipt
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get the receipt of a confirmed transaction. Returns status (success/fail), gas used, logs, contract address if deployment.

tools.name: chain_code
tools.description: Paid ($0.02). Get the deployed bytecode at an address. Returns hex bytecode (empty = EOA, non-empty = contract). Useful for distinguishing contracts from wallets.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "iban_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Covers 50 countries." → after: "Paid ($0.05). Validate an IBAN: ISO 13616 structure, country registration, length, MOD 97-10 checksum. Returns pass/fail with all checks and issues. Covers 50 countries."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
